facts.fact: The Business Registration Service page says GIZ support developed an AI-powered chatbot that provides information on business registration services; it does not say the chatbot is in service.

KEN.note: The only AI named is a business registration information chatbot, which is general administration, not a sector system.
Nothing on a model, dataset or AI computing built in the country.

facts.fact: The Business Registration Service says IFC support covered digitization of all Company Registry records, an electronic document management system and integration of the companies, e-collateral, hire purchase and Official Receiver registries.

The Business Registration Service says GIZ support led to an online Beneficial Ownership Information Register operationalised for private companies by 2020, with the Companies (Beneficial Ownership Information) Regulations 2020 being implemented.

KEN.note: Nothing on the central bank or payment systems.
Nothing on digital financial consumer protection.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Stakeholder forums on beneficial ownership are named, but no named digital law or policy and no dated consultation by government.
